Anant Ambani donates hair at Tirumala temple

Anant Ambani visited the Tirumala Sri Venkateswara Swami Temple on Sunday. During his visit, he participated in the Suprabhata Seva, offered prayers to Lord Sri Venkateswara, and donated his hair. He also fed elephants at the temple.
